import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:400]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:400])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}
def frames(extra=()):
    return [{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]+list(extra)
def case(name='a', fr=None):
    return {"name":name,"frames":frames() if fr is None else fr,"expect":EXPECT}

# --- random token inside an expression string literal stays literal
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x<<random_string>>y'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('token in expr literal', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]['sent'], fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x<<random_string>>y',True)))
# and in an expression template outside a literal -> invalid expression
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ <<random_string>> }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
check('token alone invalid', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

# --- datagram after request end is a send error
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
                                       {"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"g"}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('datagram after end', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['sent']['n']), ('send_error',0,1,13+1+1+8+1+1))

# --- zero frame case times out at timeout_ms
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('empty case timeout', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']), ('timeout',10,0))

# --- close at time 0 after all case starts
doc = base(cases=[case('a'),case('b')],events=[{"at":0,"kind":"close"}])
cs=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']
check('close at zero', [(c['state'],c['at']) for c in cs], [('closed',0),('closed',0)])

# --- pause completions in case-array order at the same time
doc = base(timeout_ms=100,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":3},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT},
                  {"name":"b","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":3},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"B","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
cs=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']
# the close is dispatched before pause completions at t=3, so both are closed with no data emitted
check('pause vs close order', [(c['state'],c['frames']) for c in cs], [('closed',0),('closed',0)])

# --- events at equal time in input order: response end accepted before close
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":2},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":False},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"ok","end":True},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"close"}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('event order at tie', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames'],c['response_body']), ('closed',2,2,fp(b'ok')))
check('receipt keeps accepted', c['received'], fp(action(2,0,'h',[(b':status',b'200')],False)+action(2,0,'d',b'ok',True)))

# --- null owner inside a request span
req = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'
doc = base(cases=[case('a')],channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[
    {"case":"a","data":req[:6].decode()},{"case":None,"data":req[6:12].decode()},{"case":"a","data":req[12:].decode()}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
q=r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('null middle owners', q['owners'], [['a',6+len(req)-12],[None,6]])
check('null middle flags', q['flags'], ['mixed_owner'])
check('null middle case flags', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin','mixed_origin'])
check('null middle owner', q['owner'], 'a')

# --- request fully unattributed except the first byte null
doc = base(cases=[case('a')],channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[
    {"case":None,"data":req[:6].decode()},{"case":"a","data":req[6:].decode()}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
q=r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('null first owner', (q['owner'],q['owners'],q['flags']), (None,[[None,6],['a',len(req)-6]],['mixed_owner','unattributed']))
check('null first case', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['missing_origin'])

# --- events for a case that is still paused are retained
doc = base(timeout_ms=50,cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":5},{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"A","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
c=run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('retained while paused', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames']), ('ok',5,1))

# --- three requests with owners a, a, b: extra flags
doc = base(cases=[case('a'),case('b')],channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[
    {"case":"a","data":req.decode()},{"case":"a","data":req.decode()},{"case":"b","data":req.decode()}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('extra per owner', [q['flags'] for q in r['channels'][0]['requests']], [[],['extra'],[]])
check('origin counts', [c['origin_count'] for c in r['cases']], [2,1])
check('case flags a', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])

# --- same owner across two channels: second channel request is extra
doc = base(cases=[case('a')],channels=[{"name":"e1","parts":[{"case":"a","data":req.decode()}]},
                                       {"name":"e2","parts":[{"case":"a","data":req.decode()}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('extra across channels', (r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], r['channels'][1]['requests'][0]['flags']), ([],['extra']))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
